newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI approves Bombay bourse expansion.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI approves Bombay bourse expansion.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said on Tuesday its board has approved the Bombay Stock Exchange's (BSE) proposal to expand to other cities subject to certain conditions.

SEBI said stock exchanges proposing to install trading terminals in cities where other bourses are already located will be required to reach an understanding with other exchanges permitting it to install their terminals.
The exchange proposing such expansion will have to open its membership to brokers of other stock exchanges.

"The terms of membership including a reasonable price would be decided by the concerned exchange, but would not exceed what is being offered to its own new members at the city where the stock exchange is located," the regulatory body said.
SEBIU emphasised that the exchange must ensure adequate monitoring and surveillance mechanism for such outstation terminals in order to oversee the trade.
The exchanges will also have to introduce the system of guaranteeing trades or set up a clearing corporation, SEBI said.
